mistake_types.description: The code cannot be parsed as Python.
A name is undefined or used outside its scope.
A value has a type that is incompatible with an operation.
A boundary is one position too early or too late.
A lookup uses an invalid index or missing key.
A branch condition behaves incorrectly for some inputs.
Iteration, termination, or state updates inside a loop are incorrect.
A function receives the wrong arguments or returns the wrong result.
A value is initialized, reset, or mutated at the wrong point.
The code fails on a special input not covered by a more specific category.
